native_contract: Without R1KH_HARD_RETRY, automatic KEY_REQ is emitted and AUTH proceeds to the null-cache/PMKID refusal without waiting. The later IAPP cache update supports a subsequent AUTH attempt.
With R1KH_HARD_RETRY, native code waits up to 30ms and loops at R1KH_QUERY.
integration_correction: The earlier blanket request-end-at-return rule is insufficient for native soft retry. Choose explicit synchronous end/cancel versus detached adapter-owned waiting request; never cancel every request solely because AUTH returned.
remaining: Independent detached-response ownership/admission and atomic cache update
No completion of a subsequent invocation from a detached reply
Detached request expiry/retry replacement and delete/generation retirement
Native producer/consumer integration and target feature compilation
